market_context: United States; USDA FSIS home-storage guidance for fresh chicken
title: How Long Does Raw Chicken Last in the Fridge?

seo.title: How Long Raw Chicken Lasts in the Fridge
seo.meta_description: USDA recommends using or freezing fresh raw chicken within 1–2 days at 40°F/4°C or below. Learn what opening, thawing and package dates change.
seo.search_intent: Know how long raw chicken can be refrigerated and when to cook, freeze or discard it.

excerpt: USDA recommends cooking or freezing fresh raw chicken within 1–2 days when the refrigerator is 40°F / 4°C or below. Smell and color can reveal obvious spoilage, but they should not be used to stretch that storage window.
content_html:
Buying chicken on Monday for “later this week” sounds reasonable until Thursday arrives and the package is still in the refrigerator. Fresh raw chicken has a short home-storage window: USDA recommends using or freezing it within 1–2 days at 40°F / 4°C or below.

That short window matters more than whether the chicken still looks pink or smells mild. Sensory checks can identify obvious spoilage; they cannot prove that a perishable food is microbiologically safe.

The simple timeline

SituationWhat to do
Fresh raw chicken brought homeRefrigerate promptly
Within 1–2 daysCook or freeze
Not cooking it soonFreeze before the window is stretched
Chicken thawed in the refrigeratorCook within another 1–2 days

The refrigerator has to be cold enough

The 1–2 day guidance assumes a refrigerator at 40°F / 4°C or colder. Store chicken in a leak-proof package or container on a low shelf so raw juices cannot drip onto produce or ready-to-eat foods.

A package that spent hours in a warm car does not get a fresh two-day window just because it eventually reached the refrigerator.

Opening the package does not reset the clock

Opening creates more opportunities for contamination from hands, utensils and surfaces. If the manufacturer gives a specific instruction after opening, follow it, but do not treat opening as the start of a new two-day period.

What about the date printed on the package?

In the U.S., date labels such as “sell by” are often used for inventory or quality rather than acting as a universal federal safety deadline. They do not replace safe storage practices. USDA's 1–2 day home-storage guidance remains a useful rule once fresh chicken is in your refrigerator.

If the package carries a specific manufacturer safety instruction or use-by direction, follow that instruction as well.

Smell cannot extend the storage window

A sour, rotten or clearly abnormal odor and a sticky or slimy surface are reasons to discard chicken. But the reverse is not true: normal-smelling chicken is not automatically safe.

Foodborne pathogens may be present without changing odor, color or texture. Time and temperature therefore carry more weight than a sniff test.

What if it has been three or four days?

Three or four days in the refrigerator is already beyond USDA's 1–2 day recommendation for fresh raw chicken. Freezing it at that point does not erase the extra refrigerated time.

If you know on day one that you will not cook it soon, freezing early gives you a much clearer decision than inspecting it several days later.

Thawed chicken has its own clock

Chicken thawed in the refrigerator can remain there for an additional 1–2 days before cooking. Chicken thawed in cold water or the microwave should be cooked immediately because parts of it may warm during thawing.

The rule worth remembering

For fresh raw chicken at home: 1–2 days in the refrigerator, then cook or freeze. A bad smell can tell you to throw it out sooner; a normal smell cannot award extra days.

faq.question: Can raw chicken stay in the fridge for 3 days?
faq.answer: USDA recommends only 1–2 days for fresh raw chicken at 40°F/4°C or below. Three days is beyond that home-storage window.

faq.question: Does the sell-by date mean chicken is safe until that date?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. U.S. package dates are often related to quality or store inventory. Safe home storage time and manufacturer instructions still matter.

faq.question: How long can thawed chicken stay in the refrigerator?
faq.answer: Chicken thawed in the refrigerator can generally remain there another 1–2 days before cooking.
